encoding.fieldElement: BN254 scalar field element, serialized as a 32-byte big-endian value
encoding.order: Declaration order of `pub` parameters in noir/zkc_aggregation/src/main.nr main(); arrays are flattened element-wise
encoding.integers: Unsigned integers are zero-extended into a single field element
encoding.byteArrays: [u8; N] occupies N field elements, one byte per element, in array order

publicInputs.name: aggregation_commitment
publicInputs.description: Poseidon2 commitment over (context, holderCommitment, per-slot proof commitments and types) with the ZKC aggregation domain

publicInputs.name: aggregated_claim_binding
publicInputs.description: H(aggregationCommitment, context); binds the aggregate to the proof context

publicInputs.name: holder_commitment
publicInputs.description: Shared holder commitment; every active component proof must carry it. MUST be non-zero

publicInputs.name: context
publicInputs.description: Deployment/profile-defined replay context hash; MUST be non-zero

publicInputs.name: input_proof_commitments
publicInputs.description: Per-slot component proof commitments (Poseidon2 over vk, proof bytes, public inputs, proof type); inactive slots MUST be zero
